messages:
Anna (CS): Glyph Labs reported a reproducible embedding drift after session resume. They say identical input returns different vectors which breaks their kNN search. Repro steps and logs below.

Luis (Support): Customer on Dedicated, region: eu-west-1, model pinned: redwood-embed-1.0-quant (customer-side quant). No code changes from their side.

Anna (CS): Repro steps from customer:
1) Create session: POST /v1/sessions -> session_id: sess_abc123
2) POST /v1/embeddings with {"session_id":"sess_abc123","input":"What is Redwood?"} -> vector A
3) Resume session: reconnect using session_token
4) POST /v1/embeddings with same payload -> vector B (different)

Customer payload (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1.0-quant","session_id":"sess_abc123","input":"What is Redwood?"}'
```

Example vectors (truncated):
vector A: [0.023, -0.112, 0.331, ...]
vector B: [0.115, -0.098, 0.290, ...]

Luis (Support): They tried 3x and got different results 3/3. Attached logs show kv-cache cleared on resume: "KV cache miss for session sess_abc123 at 2025-10-03T14:05:22Z"

Ryan (Sales): This is blocking their renewal next week. Need triage and ETA.

Matt (PM): Assigning to eng for repro. Acceptance criteria: reproduce locally or on staging, identify root cause (session resume caching vs deterministic seed), and propose remediation or mitigation + migration note for customers. Also need test to prevent regression.

Jess (Eng): I'll take this. Quick questions: which runtime (cuda 80 vs 90), backend commit hash, and do they have dedicated quantized variant or we run quantization at runtime? Also need customer sample IDs and full logs. I'll open GH issue and mark P1 if repro is solid.

sre-bot: New support ticket created: #CS-9845

Anna (CS): Adding logs and customer's test script to the ticket now. @Jess (Eng) I've uploaded logs and the raw vectors.

Jess (Eng): Thanks. I'll try to reproduce on a dedicated small pool with the quantized model pinned. If I can repro, I'll add a minimal repro script and a failing unit test. ETA 48h for initial investigation.

Matt (PM): Good. @Ryan (Sales) let customer know we're on it and ask for any extra constraints (SLA). If they push, escalate to Eng Lead.

Ryan (Sales): Noted. I'll message them and ask for permission to share logs with infra for deeper debug.

Anna (CS): Customer gave permission.

Jess (Eng): Two immediate hypotheses: 1) KV cache isn't being restored on resume leading to different prefix handling; 2) Nondeterministic quantized matmul on certain drivers. Will validate both. Can someone repro same behavior with a non-quantized model? @Luis (Support)

Luis (Support): Will test with redwood-embed-1.0 (non-quant) and report here.

Anna (CS): Marking this thread for product backlog intake. Matt, please add to next triage board with priority and acceptance criteria.

Matt (PM): Added to triage board as 'customer-repro-embed-drift' with priority P1. Linked CS-9845 and GH issue pending.

Jess (Eng): Quick note: if it's driver nondeterminism we might need to pin deterministic kernels or add a post-normalization tolerance for embeddings. Will update.

Anna (CS): Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread. :eyes:
